{{Quest rewards
|name = The Great Brain Robbery

*{{SCP|Prayer|6,000}} [[Prayer]] experience
*{{SCP|Crafting|3,000}} [[Crafting]] experience
*{{SCP|Construction|2,000}} [[Construction]] experience
*[[Blessed lamp]] ({{SCP|Overall|5,000}} experience in a chosen skill above level 30 and can be placed in your bank)
*[[Barrelchest anchor]] (To repair your barrelchest anchor, return to [[Mos Le'Harmless]] and make sure you have a [[book o' piracy]] in your inventory; then, go to the docks south of the bank and talk to "[[Smith]]." He can fix your anchor for 230,000 coins.)
*[[Prayer book]]
*Ability to cast [[Harmony Island Teleport]] on the [[Arceuus spellbook]]
*Ability to fight the [[Barrelchest]] within the [[Nightmare Zone]].
